description.text: Opened in 1987, the Department of Computer Science and Technology is the earliest engineering major of Hubei Institute of Automotive Industry, and the early professional name is "Computer Application". In 1996, in accordance with the professional objectives of the State Education Commission, the professional name was changed to "Computer Science and Technology". In 2014, it was approved as a "professional comprehensive reform" major in Hubei Province, in 2016 it was approved as a Sino-foreign cooperative school-running project of the Ministry of Education, in 2018 it was approved by the Ministry of Education's first batch of new engineering research and practice projects, and in 2019, it was approved as a "first-class undergraduate major" construction site in Hubei Province.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Hubei University Of Automotive Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Copy of Passport and Photo; 2.Diploma, Certificate and Transcript; 3.Bank Statement; 4.Application form 5.Physical Examination Report; 6.Police Clearance

requirements.text: High school certificate, aged between 18 and 25 for bachelor application Bachelor Diploma,aged between 20 and 35, HSK4 for master application
